name: Souls Combat
desc:
Experience Souls Combat: Remastered here! With mobile support as well!
https://www.roblox.com/games/6540690875/Souls-Combat-Remastered-ALPHA

In-game rules:
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/souls-combat-in-game-rules/749392

-Souls can be obtained by defeating other players.
-Please read the class description to get a better understand of it's moves
[You can play the game on mobile/tablet]

Z, X and C to attack
V to roll / air dash
B to counter
1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 to do a special attacks
F to use smash
hold R to shield
H to taunt
Ctrl to lock-on

Join the group to have a 25% chance of a getting more souls when collecting one.
Premium players get a 50% chance of getting more souls when collecting one. (it stacks with the 25% from the group)
